title: A Little Booze Doesn't Hurt...
description: Nimrod wants to enjoy a few drinks from the tavern, but he needs some help to deal with his wife...

mainQuestExcel.title: A Little Booze Doesn't Hurt...

dialogs.text: Boy do I need a drink...
But if Eury catches me drinking, it'll be the end of me.
Is everything okay?
Huh? Oh... It's fine, I just fancy a little drink is all.
My wife Eury can't stand it when I drink, though, so I never touch the stuff at home.
All I can do is wait till she's gone out shopping and then slip out for a few quick ones.
The first step is admitting you have a problem...
Hey! Don't be like that. I'm hardly the only person in Mondstadt who's fond of a drink.
But could you go and distract Eury for a while? Just long enough for one or two brews, you know?
Whenever Eury goes shopping, all it takes is a little too much choice and she'll be there all day trying to make up her mind!
She's guaranteed to keep thinking it over as long as you can keep making sure there's another option...
Okay...
Haha, excellent! May your glasses forever flow with the fine wine of good fortune, my friends!
How long do you plan on drinking for, exactly?
Ho-ho, well that depends how long you can...
...N—No, I just need enough time to enjoy one nice drink without having to down it...
Just the one, I swear! You can always trust a tavern-goer in Mondstadt!
Hmm... Sunsettias or apples? Decisions, decisions...
*sigh* I wish Nimrod were here, I'd just pick what he wants...
Apologies, Eury ma'am. We're all out of sunsettias.
Oh, I see. Well, I guess it will have to be apples, then.
Ooh... Sorry Eury, I think these apples are starting to turn...
Really? Hmm... but there's no other choice.
Allow us!
Huh? Allow you to...?
To help.
Relax. We'll find some fresh <color=#00E1FFFF>sunsettias</color> for you.
...You will? Um, well thanks...!
This is great, Nimrod much prefers sunsettias to apples. I'll wait here then.

It's so kind of you to get me some sunsettias, Beatrice bought the last ones just before I got here.
I really am grateful to you... You know what? My husband recently quit drinking for my sake, and he's been so miserable since...
Maybe some of his favorite fruit will cheer him up a bit.
That said... The apples are better value for money...
#{NICKNAME}, let's go get those sunsettias pronto!
We need to keep Eury umm-ing and ahh-ing for as long as possible.
Is it just me or it is weird that Nimrod understands his wife so well?

Judging by the smell, I'd say he's had more than one...
Eury is struggling with a big decision as we speak.
Great... great! I, uh... I guess I have time for another then! Bartender—
Oi! You said just the one! You said you swear!
Hehe... I did, didn't I? Just the one... I swear— I swear this next one is just the one for me! Haha! Bartender...
Thank you, my friends. Please, take these. My gift to you.
